title.rendered: Greater Is He Who Is in You: The Gospel For Today

content.rendered:
The One who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world. Greater. Not equal to. Not a fair match against. Greater. When the enemy tests the boundary of your life, he is meeting the resident Spirit of God, and he is outmatched.

The Gospel For Today | Monday, July 20, 2026

Today’s Scripture

“You, dear children, are from God and have overcome them, because the one who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world.”
1 John 4:4 (NIV)

Today’s Message

John writes 1 John near the end of his life. He is old. He has watched the church battle for a generation with false teachers, spiritual counterfeits, and cultural pressure. He has seen believers wobble under the weight of it. He has also seen the resilience of those who remain rooted in Christ. Into that experience, he writes to the church with the quiet confidence of an elderly grandfather. Little children, you have overcome them. And here is why.

The reason John gives is not the believer’s spiritual maturity. Not their theological sophistication. Not their moral track record. Not their institutional connection to a strong church. The reason is a resident. The One who is in you is greater than the one who is in the world. The internal Spirit of God is greater than the external spirit of the age. The overcoming is not something the believer produces. It is something the resident Spirit accomplishes through the believer, because He is greater than any spirit outside the believer that would come against them.

The comparison John draws is stark. He uses the Greek word meizōn, which means larger, greater in size or degree or importance. There is no equivalence being suggested. There is no fair contest being described. The One inside the believer is not a slight favourite to win against the one in the world. He is decisively, categorically, immeasurably greater. Whatever comes against the believer today has to meet the resident Spirit before it can reach the believer’s identity in Christ. And it will lose.

This is one of the most important truths for a believer under attack to hold on to. When fear rises, the response is not to summon more courage. It is to remember that the One in you is greater than the fear knocking on the door. When anxiety builds, the response is not to bury it. It is to remember that the resident Peace of God is greater than every anxious voice. When sickness declares its diagnosis, the response is not to negotiate. It is to remember that the Healer inside is greater than the sickness outside. When the enemy accuses you of your past, the response is not to defend yourself. It is to remember that the Advocate inside is greater than the accuser outside.

For Gospelbuzz readers, the truth this morning is decisive. You are not the smaller party in any spiritual conflict you face today. You carry the resident Spirit of the living God. Whatever comes against you is meeting Him before it meets you. And He is greater. Walk in that reality today.

Prayer

Father, I acknowledge that the One who lives in me is greater than the one who is in the world. The resident Spirit of the living God is inside me. Whatever comes against me today is meeting Him before it reaches my identity in Christ. Fear is smaller than the Spirit in me. Anxiety is smaller than the Spirit in me. Sickness is smaller than the Spirit in me. The accuser is smaller than the Advocate in me. I walk in that reality today, not as the smaller party but as one who carries the greater One. In Jesus’ name. Amen.

Declaration

Greater is He who is in me than he who is in the world. Every attack meets the resident Spirit before it reaches me. He is greater. I walk in that reality today.
